description: Get ONE instrument family's rows with per-field SEC citations (accession number, filing date and the verbatim sentence each figure was read from). Families: warrants, convertibles, preferred, shelfs, atms, elocs, s1_offerings, equity_plans, exchangeables, recent_offerings. One family per call; request only what you need. 🔴 `withheldRows` / `withheldRowCount`: rows that could NOT be verified were blanked, so every family total is a LOWER BOUND; say so. An empty rows array on a covered company is a measured "none found in the filings read"; an unavailable response is not. 🔴 `disputed` status (warrants / convertibles / preferred / exchangeables): the issuer's latest filing disputes the instrument; it is SHOWN and EXCLUDED from totals (`summary.disputedInstrumentCount` / `disputedInstrumentShares`); report it as a disputed claim, never as outstanding or retired. `contingencyTrigger: "event_of_default"`: still outstanding and COUNTED; say "converts only on an event of default", never not dilutive. 🔴 convertibles `principalBasis` `aggregate_only` / `fair_value_only` / `conflict` / `undisclosed_since_issue`: the current balance is NOT MEASURED (principalOutstanding null); report `principalOriginal` as the ORIGINAL principal. `conversionBasis: "formula_unanchored"`: no share count computable; unquantified, not zero. convertibles / preferred `sharesIssuableBasis: "conflict_upper_bound"`: report "up to `sharesIssuableIfConverted`; the issuer states `sharesIssuableIssuerStated`", never the higher figure alone as the issuer's count. 🔴 warrants with null `sharesUnderlying` beside `aggregateExerciseValueDollars` / `exercisePriceFloor` / `sharesCeilingAsFiled` are dollar-denominated or capped: `summary.warrantSharesCeiling` is a ceiling, never a count and never in `potentialNewShares`. `warrantCount` counts WARRANTS, not shares. 🔴 shelfs `babyShelfCurrentCapacityDollars` is a STORED, DATED figure, NOT TODAY'S HEADROOM: always report it with `babyShelfCapacityAsOf` (null = undated, never current; `babyShelfCapacityBasis` names its float). For the raisable-now figure call get_baby_shelf_capacity; never present the stored figure as current. ALWAYS RETURNS 200: read `available` and `reason`, never the HTTP status. `not_covered` means this company has not been analysed yet, not that it has no dilution; an outage is a 5xx. NULL, absent or withheld means NOT MEASURED; it never means "no dilution", "no warrants", "no shelf" or zero. A numeric 0 is a MEASURED zero and defeats a null check: decide from the availability/withheld/reason field, never from the value itself. Figures are as of `meta.asOfDate`, from filings read through `meta.filingsThrough` (a stale date predates anything filed since). Share counts are on one split basis; a row that cannot be rebased is omitted and counted, never published on a mixed basis. Included in Signal8 Pro: without it the call returns 403 FEATURE_NOT_AVAILABLE with `requiredTier: "pro"` (a tier upgrade; there is no add-on to buy).
